seo_title: B2B Financing API: Get Paid Upfront, Sell in Installments
seo_desc: Losing sales due to client liquidity issues? We integrate B2B financing APIs so you can offer installment payments while securing your upfront payment.
author_pitch: I have seen small businesses lose large contracts for machinery or services simply because their client could not pay all at once. My mission is to connect your business with cloud credit platforms so you can offer installment payments without assuming any financial risk.
title: B2B Financing API Integration: Multiply Your Sales Without Acting as a Bank
body:
How many high-value quotes go unsigned because your corporate client lacks immediate liquidity?

When you sell industrial machinery, office furniture, or expensive consulting projects, asking for all the money upfront scares away many small companies. If you decide to offer payment terms on your own, you assume a terrible risk: if the client stops paying the third installment, your business takes the hit, you have to chase the debt, and your monthly accounts sink.

The trap of private payment agreements

Signing a paper promising monthly payments without real financial backing means you are funding your clients' purchases with your own company's money. Lending your own payroll money to close a sale is the most dangerous mistake in a B2B business.

Our solution: B2B Credit Gateway API Integration

At LANZAESTUDIO, we connect your billing software or online store with major corporate financing platforms through a fast and secure cloud API.

  1. Instant Risk Assessment: The client enters their details into your form, and the API queries the financial institution in milliseconds, approving the credit in real time.
  2. Guaranteed Full Payment: While your client pays in comfortable installments over months, the financial institution deposits 100% of the money into your account the very next day.
  3. Zero Collection Tasks: You completely forget about chasing unpaid invoices or sending reminders; the gateway handles the entire collection process.
  4. Automatic Accounting Synchronization: The invoice is instantly marked as paid in your management system, keeping your accounting books in perfect order.

The Real Impact on Your SME's Growth

  • Drastic Increase in Closings: By removing the barrier of a high initial payment, your clients make the purchasing decision much faster and without asking for discounts.
  • Total Liquidity in Your Account: You have the money available immediately to reinvest in your business, pay suppliers, or hire more staff.
  • Absolute Protection Against Defaulters: You transfer all the risk of non-payment to an external entity, ensuring that every signed sale is real money in your pocket.
